subject.title: fix(agents): load bootstrap files from agentDir alongside workspace

question: Should an explicitly configured `agentDir` become a second bootstrap instruction authority that overrides the agent workspace, or should it remain the agent’s state/auth directory with warnings for misplaced bootstrap files?
rationale: Both behaviors are technically possible, but choosing between them changes documented workspace ownership, upgrade behavior, instruction precedence, and the security boundary around per-agent state.

options.title: Keep workspace authoritative
options.body: Retain `agents.list[].workspace` as the sole bootstrap root and warn users when bootstrap-named files are found in `agentDir`.

options.title: Adopt dual-root bootstrap
options.body: Approve `agentDir` overrides, then require complete docs, setup, migration, precedence, multi-agent, and security coverage before merge.

options.title: Pause this implementation
options.body: Close or pause this PR while the canonical issue and the warning implementation at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97653 settle the supported direction.

recommendation.title: Keep workspace authoritative
recommendation.body: Retain `agents.list[].workspace` as the sole bootstrap root and warn users when bootstrap-named files are found in `agentDir`.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal is the prior product-level review affirming workspace-local bootstrap authority.
